$comment: Audio build recipes for scripts/build-audio.mjs (pnpm audio). Sources are fetched by assets-src/audio/fetch.mjs. Times in seconds of the source file; gain in dB; filter = ffmpeg filter chain; rate = varispeed (pitch+speed).

categories.$comment: loudness = target max 200 ms K-weighted loudness (LUFS-ish) after peak-normalising to -3 dBFS; gain only ever goes down. Loops with measure "mean" use whole-file loudness.
